full_prompt_en: A tightly framed cinematic photograph places a young man and a woman side by side in warm, low light. The man occupies the left half, his face turned slightly right and his pale greenish eyes looking forward with a focused expression. Wavy light-brown hair falls partly across the forehead rather than lying smoothly back. He wears a dark formal jacket, white shirt and black bow tie, visible near the lower-left edge before the clothing falls out of focus. The woman fills the right half, looking almost directly towards the camera beneath a broad dark hat. Reddish decoration rises near the upper crop, and the brim shades her forehead without hiding both eyes. Short light-brown curls are visible beside her cheek and beneath the hat. Her lips are a saturated dark red, and a deep burgundy garment with small reflective details appears at the right shoulder. The faces are close together and similarly large, separated by a narrow dark gap. Warm directional light shapes both foreheads, noses and cheeks, with deeper brown shadows around the eyes and along the outer contours. The woman's two eyes remain readable, while the hat creates a darker upper band. Her red lips and burgundy clothing repeat the warm colour of the surrounding shadows. Behind and below the pair, the setting dissolves into dark reddish-brown blur and a few soft amber light patches; no distinct furnishings are resolved in this close crop. Shallow depth of field keeps the faces clearer than the clothing and background. Subtle grain and smooth tonal transitions give the image a soft cinematic finish. The man's slightly angled face and the woman's more direct gaze balance the two sides, concentrating attention on their expressions within an intimate, theatrical close-up.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅紧密裁切的电影感摄影画面，一名年轻男子与一名女子并列处于温暖低照度环境中。男子占据左半部，面孔略向右转，浅绿色眼睛专注地看向前方。浅棕波浪短发部分落在额头上，并非平整向后梳。他穿深色礼服外套、白衬衫和黑领结，衣物在左下边缘可见，随即进入虚焦。女子占据右半部，宽阔深帽下的目光接近直视镜头。红色饰件在上部裁切附近升起，帽檐遮暗额头，但没有遮住双眼。脸颊旁与帽下可见浅棕短卷发。双唇为饱和暗红色，右肩出现带细小反光点的深酒红服装。两张脸相距很近，尺度相仿，中间仅隔一道窄暗隙。温暖方向光塑造两人的额头、鼻子和脸颊，眼周及外缘留有更深棕影。女子双眼仍能辨认，帽子在上方形成较暗色带，红唇与酒红衣料呼应周围暖影。两人身后及下方的场景消融为暗红棕虚化与几团柔和琥珀光斑，紧密取景中没有清楚陈设。浅景深让面孔比衣物和背景更清晰。轻微颗粒与平顺色阶赋予画面柔和电影质感。男子略侧的脸与女子更直接的目光平衡左右两边，在亲密、戏剧化近景中将注意力集中于表情。
style_prompt_en: The visual language uses close cropping, deep shadow and small warm highlights to establish focus. Forms emerge from near-black fields through smooth tonal modeling, while edges remain soft enough to blend into the surrounding darkness. A restrained palette of charcoal, black, burgundy, muted brown and occasional cream keeps saturated accents rare and effective. Directional low-key light selects a few surfaces and leaves broad areas unlit, creating depth through gradual transitions instead of hard outlines. Fine grain and painterly softness temper otherwise crisp focal details. The composition favors large forms placed close to the frame, with narrow dark gaps separating adjacent areas and small glows near an edge providing counterweight. Its mood is intimate and theatrical, shaped by controlled contrast and selective visibility.
style_prompt_zh: 这种视觉语言以紧凑裁切、深暗区域和少量暖色亮点建立焦点。形体从近乎黑色的底色中通过平顺的明暗塑形逐渐显现，边缘则保持柔和，能够融入周围暗部。炭灰、黑色、酒红、低调棕色和偶尔出现的奶油白构成克制色谱，使饱和色点缀显得稀少而有效。低调且有方向性的光线只选择性照亮部分表面，大面积保持未受光状态，通过渐变而非硬轮廓形成纵深。细微颗粒和绘画式柔化平衡较清晰的焦点细节。构图偏向将大形体靠近画框，邻近区域之间留出狭窄暗隙，边缘附近的小片光亮则提供平衡。整体气氛亲密而富戏剧性，来自受控反差和选择性的可见度。
theme_en: A close cinematic double portrait of a young man turned right and a woman in a dark hat, side by side in deep shadow
theme_zh: 近景电影感双人肖像：年轻男子侧向右方，与戴深色帽子的女子并列处于暗影中
name: Baz Luhrmann
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
